input.question: Where can I see which capabilities each model supports (e.g. function calling, vision, JSON mode)?

content.content:
{"result":"You can see which capabilities each model supports in the [Model capability matrix](https://docs.mistral.ai/models) section, which lists features like function calling, vision, and JSON mode. This section includes a table showing model support for various features, such as `json_object`, `json_schema`, and function tools like `code_interpreter` and `image_generation`

For example:

```
```

The [Model capability matrix](https://docs.mistral.ai/models) is the authoritative source for this information [1].

If you need details on function calling, you can refer to the [Function Calling](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agent-tools/function-calling) documentation, which explains how to define and use tools in agents [4].

For JSON mode, the [Chat API > Chat Completion > Request body](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/chat#operation-chat_completion_v1_chat_completions_post) specifies that setting `response_format` to `{"type": "json_object"}` enables JSON mode, guaranteeing the model's output is in JSON format [2].

For vision capabilities, the [Text & Vision Fine-tuning > Dataset](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/deprecated/finetuning/text_vision_finetuning#before-you-start) section mentions that fine-tuning can include both text and image inputs, enabling models to understand and respond to visual data [7].

For predicted outputs, only the `codestral-latest` and `mistral-large-2411` models currently support this feature [3].

Sources (5 verified):
[1] [Model capability matrix](https://docs.mistral.ai/models#:~:text=Model%20capability%20matrix%20%23%20Model,model%20that%20supports%20each%20feature.) — "Model capability matrix # Model capability matrix Which Mistral models support which API features, generated from the model catalog. Each section covers one group of features: the table has one row per model and one column per feature, `yes` meaning the model supports it, and the list under the table names every model that supports each feature."
[4] [Function Calling](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agent-tools/function-calling#:~:text=The%20core%20of%20an%20agent,JSON%20schema%20for%20your%20function.) — "The core of an agent relies on its tool usage capabilities, enabling it to use and call tools and workflows depending on the task it must accomplish. Built into our API, we provide [built-in tools](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agent-tools#built-in-tools) such as `websearch`, `code_interpreter`, `image_generation` and `document_library`. However, you can also use standard function tool calling by defining a JSON schema for your function."
[2] [Chat API > Chat Completion > Request body](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/chat#operation-chat_completion_v1_chat_completions_post:~:text=Setting%20to%20%7B%20%22type%22%3A%20%22json_object%22,follows%20the%20schema%20you%20provide.) — "Setting to `{ "type": "json_object" }` enables JSON mode, which guarantees the message the model generates is in JSON. When using JSON mode you MUST also instruct the model to produce JSON yourself with a system or a user message. Setting to `{ "type": "json_schema" }` enables JSON schema mode, which guarantees the message the model generates is in JSON and follows the schema you provide."
[7] [Text & Vision Fine-tuning > Before You Start > Dataset](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/deprecated/finetuning/text_vision_finetuning#before-you-start:~:text=While%20text%2Donly%20fine%2Dtuning%20covers%20multiple,both%20text%20and%20image%20inputs.) — "While text-only fine-tuning covers multiple use cases, you can also fine-tune the vision capabilities of our models. This allows you to create models that can understand and generate responses based on both text and image inputs."
[3] [Predicted outputs > Predicted Outputs > FAQ > Which model supports predicted outputs?](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/advanced/predicted-outputs#which-model-supports-predicted-outputs:~:text=As%20of%20now%2C%20codestral%2Dlatest%20and%20mistral%2Dlarge%2D2411%20support%20predicted%20outputs.) — "As of now, `codestral-latest` and `mistral-large-2411` support predicted outputs."

content.text:
The definitive source is Mistral's **Model capability matrix**:

**https://docs.mistral.ai/models#model-capability-matrix**

It's generated from the model catalog and gives one row per model, one column per feature (e.g. function calling, JSON mode/`json_object`, `json_schema`, vision, built-in tools like `code_interpreter`/`image_generation`, etc.), with `yes` marking support, plus a list under each table naming every model that supports that feature.

A few related pages if you need feature-specific detail beyond the matrix:
- Function calling — https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agent-tools/function-calling
- JSON mode / JSON schema via `response_format` — https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/chat
- Predicted outputs support (currently only `codestral-latest` and `mistral-large-2411`) — https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/advanced/predicted-outputs#which-model-supports-predicted-outputs
